australian_revenue_share.label: Australia
australian_revenue_share.note: Note 34 (printed p.108), 'Passenger, freight and other services revenue' by geographic region: Australia 7,253.4 of allocated total 10,627.5; a further 2,021.3 of 'Other operating revenue' is unallocated; total 'Sales and operating revenue' 12,648.8. Allocation is by point of sale for international services.

checks.income_statement_identity: 12,648.8 (sales and operating revenue) - 11,528.9 (sum of 11 listed expense lines) + 1.8 (share of net profit of associates) - 211.5 (borrowing costs) + 117.0 (interest revenue) = 1,027.2 vs printed PBT 1,027.2. Derived EBIT 1,121.7 also equals printed EBIT.

issues: Pre-AIFRS (AGAAP) 'Statement of Financial Performance'; FY2006 report will restate FY2005 under AIFRS, so FY2005 is not directly comparable with later years (an AIFRS transition note appears at pdf pp.117-120).
Expenses by nature with airline-specific categories; no cost of sales or materials line. 'Fuel and oil' used as nearest consumables line (classification choice).
Statement shows both Qantas Group (consolidated) and Qantas (parent) columns; Group 2005 column used.
Employee number is average FTE from the performance summary, not the audited statements.
